implementation_qualification.capture_assertion: capture every channel and require absence of every raw, projected, encoded, hashed, digested, or fingerprinted title, private-query, ISBN, provider-identity, and resource-identity value
capture_channels: exception type, message, arguments, notes, cause, and context
trace and span names, attributes, and events
metric names, labels, values, and exemplars
negative_failing_tests: inject each raw forbidden source into every captured channel and require privacy qualification failure
inject normalized/projected/tokenized/length-derived/encoded forms into every captured channel and require failure
inject hash/digest/fingerprint forms into every captured channel and require failure
inject forbidden values into exception cause/context, trace/span attributes/events, and metric names/labels/values/exemplars and require failure
emit legacy C1 query_file_opened or any other result key containing query and require schema plus scan failure

spies.exceptions: capture raised and handled exception type/message/args/notes/cause/context; fail on any forbidden source form
spies.hashing: fail on any hash/digest/fingerprint call containing or derived from title, private-query, ISBN, provider identity, or resource identity
spies.metrics: capture metric names, labels, values, and exemplars; fail on any forbidden source form
spies.persistence_export_reporting: capture database/audit writes, stdout/stderr, logs, exports, and reports; fail on any forbidden source form
spies.tracing: capture trace/span names, attributes, and events; fail on any forbidden source form

implementation_qualification.status: required at each installed head and activation
implementation_qualification.title_pair: run two valid synthetic inputs differing only in local title; compare allowlisted typed fields without computing or exporting any input digest

checked: C2 canonical input, output, schema, and variant matrix
